Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic Resigns to Seek Prime Minister Role

Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic has announced his resignation from the presidency to run for prime minister in the upcoming October elections. Vucic is described as an ally of Benjamin Netanyahu.
